attacks.name: Hellfire Blasters
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

attacks.name: Power Cosmic Penance Stare
steps: The defender does not gain |!power| for |!damage| dealt by this attack.
|!critical| |!wild| |!hit| |!block| |!failure| |*Dust to Dust|: Change each of the defender's |!block| results to a |!failure|.

superPowers.name: Interstellar Hellcycle
superPowers.body: This character may spend 1 to 5 |!power| to use this superpower. Place this character within |!range| X of its current position, where X is the amount of |!power| spent. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Chains of Cyttorak
superPowers.body: Choose a character within |!range| 3 of this character and Push it Toward this character |!range_small|. Then the chosen character gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Cosmic Justice on Wheels
superPowers.body: If an allied character is Dazed or KO'd by an enemy effect, after the effect is resolved, this character may use this superpower. It makes a |*Hellfire Blasters| attack against the enemy character that caused the effect.

superPowers.name: I‘m the Spirit of Vengeance, Bearer of the Power Cosmic, and Just A Bit Unstable
superPowers.body: During the |*Cleanup Phase|, remove all |<psychosis>Psychosis| tokens from this character. Then, this character rolls 5 dice. For each |!critical|, |!wild|, and |!hit| results rolled, this character gains 1 |!power|. Then, if this character has 5 or more |!power|, this character gains a Psychosis token and drops all objective tokens it is holding.

superPowers.name: Ready to Roll
superPowers.body: At the start of the first |*Power Phase| and when this character would be Dazed, this character gains a |<psychosis>Psychosis| token. While it has a Psychosis token, it counts |!failure| results in its attack, defense, and dodge rolls as successes. While this character has a Psychosis token, it cannot hold, Contest, or Interact with objective tokens. This character can have a maximum of one Psychosis token at any time.

superPowers.name: Flight, Immunity [Bleed, Hex, Incinerate, Poison], Peerless

erratas.body: Power Cosmic Penance Stare's Power cost increased from 6 to 8.
Chains of Cyttorak can now be used only once per turn instead of being able to affect every character once per turn.
The Psychosis token mechanism was reworked through changes to "I‘m the Spirit of Vengeance, Bearer of the Power Cosmic, and Just A Bit Unstable" and "Ready to Roll" innate superpowers.
